editorial.blurb: Khmai brings authentic Cambodian flavors to Chicago with bold, beautifully balanced sauces and generous, shareable dishes that rival restaurants in Cambodia itself.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server about the fine-dining tasting menu option when reserving, and note that Khmai proper differs from the casual Kaun Khmai sister restaurant next door—specify which you prefer when booking.
signatureDishes: Sang Ko Ang Share Plate (braised beef ribs with sweet chili and BBQ sauce)
